title: From Finite-Node Conifold Geometry to BPS Structures I: Algebraic State Data
summary: Let $π:X\to Δ$ be a one-parameter degeneration whose central fiber $X_0$ is a complex threefold with finitely many ordinary double points $Σ=\{p_1,\dots,p_r\}\subset X_0$. Associated with this degeneration is the corrected finite-node perverse extension, together with its mixed-Hodge-module refinement and a finite-node schober datum whose perverse-sheaf shadow is identified with the corrected perverse sheaf $\mathcal P$. The purpose of the present paper is to extract from these finite-node geometric, extension-theoretic, mixed-Hodge, and categorical inputs the intrinsic algebraic state data…
